eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults aged 18 to 60 years.
* Male and female participants
* Patients requiring surgical extraction of a mandibular molar.
* American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) Physical Status I or II
* Able and willing to provide written informed consent and comply with study follow-up

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant or lactating women.
* Patients with systemic conditions that contraindicate oral surgery (e.g., uncontrolled diabetes mellitus or immunosuppressive disorders).
* Current use of antibiotics or medications that may interfere with wound healing (e.g., anticoagulants or bisphosphonates).
* Known allergy or hypersensitivity to tetracycline or related antibiotics.
* Requirement for simultaneous extraction of adjacent teeth.
* Presence of active oral infection, including pericoronitis, at the surgical site.
* Severely compromised oral hygiene that may affect postoperative healing.
* Individuals who are unable to cooperate with the study procedures or attend follow-up visits because of physical or cognitive impairment.

identificationModule.briefTitle: Effect of Intraoperative Tetracycline on Postoperative Pain After Mandibular Molar Extraction
